liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Listener specifically enjoys the way this song sounded in 1973 [15]
- **Clear the Aisles** (1 review): Listener calls the first part of this song the greatest banter ever [10]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Listener highlights healthy feedback and space in the final minutes [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.clugston.6648.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 205 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the soundboard recording as clear and crisp; Listener rates the sound quality of the recording as very good; A one-second static burst occurs at the four-minute mark of Big River [1][10][14]
- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.miller.112205.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 226 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.degen.110781.flac1644**: audience recording; 29 songs; 198 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Listener finds the current transfer sounds better than their early 80s cassettes [16]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.maloney.98049.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 234 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [7]

## Around the show

- Cops tried clearing aisles; a lead officer waved from the stage [13]
- Band continued playing as lights came on, ignoring the disturbance [13]
- Donna sat out the show to give birth to her son, Boombox [20]
- Bobby screamed at audience members dancing in the aisles during Uncle [20]
- Phil calmly swayed heads back to seats after the Uncle segment [20]
- Listener realized they were a fan, not a true Deadhead, at this show [3]
- Listener was amazed by the size of the Wall of Sound stage [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.clugston.6648.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > DAT> CDR [1]. Also: Listener speculates the first three tracks are likely sound checks; Uploader preserved a segue between Half-Step and Playin' in the Band [1][14]
- **gd1973-12-01.sbd.miller.112205.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Uploader notes all disc changes in the set are seamless [2]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.degen.110781.flac1644**: taped by Bill Degen. This transfer is 1st Gen cassettes, kindly provided by Tim Friend.; transferred by Transfer by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD Source: Unknown equipment > MAC. [6]. Also: Recording derives from Bill Degen's reels, transferred in the early 80s [16]
- **gd1973-12-01.aud.maloney.98049.flac16**: source: AUDIENCE ANALOG MASTER>CDR [7]. Also: Joe Maloney made this specific audience recording available for download [7]
